content: Yinni Gusunɔn dɑm mu Esekiɛli nɛnuɑ mɑ mu win bwɛ̃rɑ suɑ mu kɑ dɑ wɔwɑ ɡɑɑn suunu sɔɔ. Wɔwɑ ye sɔɔ, kukunɑ nu yibɑ.
Mɑ dɑm mɛ, mu derɑ u sĩɑ kuku nin suunu sɔɔ. U deemɑ nu dɑbi wɔwɑ ye sɔɔ, mɑ nu ɡbere woko woko.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, kuku ni, nu koo kpĩ nu wɑ̃ɑru wɑ? Mɑ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ ɑ yɛ̃ mɛ, Yinni.
Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡɑri ɡeruo kuku ɡbebu nin sɔ̃ ɑ nu sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, nu nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio nu nɔ.
Nɑ nɛɛ, kon nu hunde kpɑɑ wɛ̃ kpɑ nu mɑɑ se nu n wɑ̃ɑ.
Kon nu sĩi kpɑɑnu wɛ̃ kpɑ n de nu wɑsi kpɑrɑ. Kon nu hunde kpɑɑ wɛ̃ kpɑ nu se nu n wɑ̃ɑ. Sɑɑ yerɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Mɑ Esekiɛli u ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Sɑnɑm mɛ u ɡɑri yi mɔ̀, yerɑ u dɑmu ɡɑɡu kɑ yĩiribu ɡɑbu nuɑ mɑ kuku ni, nu susinɑ.
Yerɑ u wɑ nu sĩinu kuɑ mɑ nu wɑsi kpɑrɑ, ɑdɑmɑ nu ǹ ɡinɑ hunde mɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, ɑ ɡɑri ɡeruo ɑ hunde sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, hunde yu nɑ sɑɑ hɑnduniɑn ɡoonu nnɛn di kpɑ yu ɡoo ni wom wure kpɑ nu se nu n wɑ̃ɑ.
Mɑ u ɡɑri ɡeruɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Mɑ hunde yɑ nɑ ni sɔɔ, nu wɑ̃ɑru wɑ mɑ nu seewɑ nu yɔ̃rɑ. Nu dɑbi nɡe tɑbu kowobu.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, kuku ni, nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isirelibɑ. Wee bɑ mɔ̀, ben kukunu nu ɡberɑ. Ben yĩiyɔbu bu doonɑ mɑ bɑ kɔ̃ɔrɑ.
Yen sɔ̃ tɛ̃, ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, wee kon be, nɛn tɔmbun sikɑ wukiɑ kpɑ n bu yɑrɑ min di n kɑ bu wurɑmɑ ben temɔ.
Nɑ̀ n bu kuɑ mɛ, bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Kon bu nɛn Hunde dokeɑ kpɑ bu wɑ bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ. Kon de bu wurɑ bu sinɑ ben temɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡɑri ɡeruɑ nɑ mɑɑ yi kuɑ.
Yudɑbɑ kɑ Isirelibɑn bɑndɑ
koo ko teeru
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ,
wunɛ tɔnun bii, ɑ dɑ̃ɑ kukuru ɡɑru suo kpɑ ɑ Yudɑbɑn bɑndun yĩsiru yore ten wɔllɔ. Kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ kukuru ɡɑru suɑ ɑ Isirelibɑn bɑndun yĩsiru yore ten wɔllɔ.
Kpɑ ɑ dɑ̃ɑ kukunu yiru ye swɛɛnɑ nu ko nɡe dɑ̃ɑ kuku teeru wunɛn nɔmɑ sɔɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ tɔmbɑ koo nun bikiɑ bu nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ kɑɑ sun dɑ̃ɑ yen tubusiɑnu sɔ̃?
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ kɑɑ bu wisi ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, kon Isirelibɑn bɑndun dɑ̃ɑ kuku te suɑ kpɑ n tu swɛɛnɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑn bɑnduɡiru nu ko dɑ̃ɑ kuku teeru nɛn nɔmɑɔ.
Dɑ̃ɑ kuku ni, nu ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ wunɛn nɔmɑɔ bɑ n wɑɑmɔ.
A mɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, wee, kon Isirelibɑ mɛnnɑmɑ beri berikɑn di mi bɑ yɑrinɛ bwesenu sɔɔ, kpɑ n de bu wurɑmɑ ben temɔ.
Bɑ koo ko bwese teeru sere kɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡuunɔ kpɑ bɑ n sunɔ turo mɔ. Bɑ ǹ ko n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ bwesenu yiru. Bɑ ǹ ko n mɑɑ sinɑmbu yiru mɔ.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ tii disi dokemɔ ben bũu sɑ̃ɑnun sɔ̃ kɑ ben torɑnun sɔ̃. Kon bu yɑrɑmɑwɑ mi bɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɑ kɑ torɑ kpuron di. Kon bu dɛɛrɑsiɑwɑ mɑm mɑm. Bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛn tɔmbu kpɑ nɑ n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben Yinni.
Dɑfidi nɛn sɔm kowon bibun bweseru sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo sunɔ wɑ. Kpɑro turowɑ bɑ ko n mɔ. Bɑ koo nɛn woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ kpɑ bu kɑ ye sɔmburu ko.

Bɑ koo wure bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ mɛ nɑ nɛn sɔm kowo Yɑkɔbu wɛ̃. Miyɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ sinɑ. Ben tii bɑ koo mɑɑ sinɑ mi sere kɑ ben bibun bibɔ kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Dɑfidin bibun bweserɑ tɑ ko n bɑndu dii mi sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Kon kɑ bu ɑrukɑwɑni bɔri yɛnduɡiɑ bɔke ye yɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Kon de bu sinɑ tem mi, kpɑ bu dɑbiɑ. Kpɑ n nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yeru ɡirɑ ben suunu sɔɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Nɛn wɑ̃ɑ yeru tɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ ben suunu sɔɔ. Bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛn tɔmbu kpɑ nɑ n sɑ̃ɑ ben Yinni.
Nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yeru tɑ̀ n wɑ̃ɑ ben suunu sɔɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ, sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bwesenu nu koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wi u Isirelibɑ ɡɔsɑ nɛnɛm.
Gɑri yi bɑ ɡeruɑ Gɔɡun sɔ̃
